entities.summary: Titus Vibius Varus was a Roman senator who was ordinary consul in AD 134 as the colleague of Lucius Julius Ursus Servianus, the brother-in-law of the emperor Hadrian. He is known from inscriptions and the Digest ; he is also attested by a military diploma, which shows, that he was still in office on April 2, together with Titus Haterius Nepos as his colleague.
